SELECT ROUND(AVG(f.first_sale_date - f.launch_date), 1)
FROM (
  -- one row per product launched in 2024 or 2025 that sold at least once
  SELECT p.product_id, p.launch_date, MIN(s.order_date) AS first_sale_date
  FROM products AS p
  JOIN sales AS s ON s.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE p.launch_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY p.product_id, p.launch_date
) AS f
